gloss: to be troubled, to be in difficulty

forms.label: ている past polite
forms.negative: {困|こま}っていませんでした

definitions.gloss: to be troubled, to have difficulty
definitions.explanation: To be in a difficult situation, to face a problem, or to not know what to do. Expresses distress or being at a loss.

examples.japanese: ⟦お{金|かね}→お金：00611_okane⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦なくて→ない：01118_nai⟧{困|こま}って⟦います→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: I'm in trouble because I don't have money.
examples.notes: ⟦ている→ている：noentry⟧ form for ongoing state

examples.japanese: {困|こま}った⟦こと→こと：01164_koto⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦あったら→ある：00006_aru⟧、⟦{言|い}って→言う：00515_iu⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: If you have any trouble, please tell me.

examples.japanese: ⟦{道|みち}→道：00505_michi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦わからなくて→分かる：00463_wakaru⟧{困|こま}りました。
examples.english: I was troubled because I didn't know the way.

examples.japanese: ⟦{電車|でんしゃ}→電車：00522_densha⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{止|と}まって→止まる：00555_tomaru⟧、{困|こま}って⟦います→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: The train has stopped and I'm in trouble.

examples.japanese: ⟦{日本語|にほんご}→日本語：00614_nihongo⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦わからなくて→分かる：00463_wakaru⟧{困|こま}って⟦いたら→いる：00495_iru⟧、⟦{親切|しんせつ}な→親切：01144_shinsetsu⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{助|たす}けて→助ける：00895_tasukeru⟧⟦くれました→くれる：00724_kureru⟧。
examples.english: When I was having trouble because I didn't understand Japanese, a kind person helped me.

notes:
TRANSITIVITY: ⟦{自動詞|じどうし}→自動詞：10977_jidoushi⟧ (intransitive). No pair verb. Pattern: X⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{困|こま}る (be troubled by X) or X⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{困|こま}る.

ASPECT: ⟦ている→ている：noentry⟧ indicates ongoing state. {困|こま}って⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧ = 'is in trouble/difficulty.'

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {困|こま}って⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧ (am in trouble)
- 〜⟦なくて→ない：01118_nai⟧{困|こま}る (be troubled because there's no ~)
- {困|こま}った (exclamation: this is a problem!)
- {困|こま}った⟦こと→こと：01164_koto⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ (unfortunately)

{困|こま}った can function as an adjective meaning 'troublesome.'
